purpose: Every user-facing function of Dev Boards / BeeZilla and where it actually exists. Two release lines serve this product — web (app.devboards.ai, github main) and desktop (BeeZilla installer, branch feat/local-runtime). This file is the contract between them: `node scripts/parity-check.mjs` fails when a page, an API family or a migration appears on one line and is not named here, or when a declaration stops being true. Divergence is allowed; unrecorded divergence is not.

web.built: git push github HEAD:main → railway redeploy --service agent-relay

rules: A function is 'both' only when it is proven present on both surfaces — evidence paths, not intentions.
A web-only function ships to the desktop by porting it to feat/local-runtime, then flipping this entry to 'both' in the same commit.
A desktop-only function stays desktop-only only if it cannot work on the web (local runtime, BYOK key store, installer). Anything else is a product decision to write down.
'drift' means present on both but behaviour is known to differ. It needs a note saying how, or it is a bug.
Cloud contracts marked in `contract` are consumed by installed desktops. Changing one is a coordinated release, never a unilateral web deploy.

contract.mints: 15-minute, inference-scoped, HMAC-signed token (bz1.<claims>.<sig>) for a desktop install
contract.breaks: a desktop install cannot chat at all; it refuses by name rather than 401
contract.verify: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X POST https://app.devboards.ai/api/inference-token → 401 anonymous is correct; a signed-in mint returns bz1.*

contract.mints: search-scoped token for the gateway route
contract.breaks: desktop search silently falls back to BYOK-only
contract.verify: desktop connect log line 'BeeZilla search connected'

contract.consumedBy: desktop runtime search.ts pointed at the cloud gateway
contract.breaks: desktop turns answer 'search is off' while the web still searches
contract.verify: web-only today — no desktop route defines it

contract.breaks: one surface streams, the other waits or drops the audio lane
contract.verify: both trees contain voice.ts + the same event names

open: Desktop voice input (recorder + ASR) is missing — the biggest user-visible gap: Firefox/Brave users cannot talk to the desktop app at all.
Desktop has no canonical nav, so its eleven pages are eleven separate navs.
Desktop has no asset shelf, so a dropped picture, song or .glb vanishes instead of becoming a card.
Desktop has no graphs/frontier/pricing/music/3D — the whole post-Oct-27 web line.
37 desktop commits lived only on one machine until 2026-11-03; branch feat/local-runtime is now on GitHub so they can be rebased rather than lost.
